description: Opens .parquet files from chat links as tables, so you can check what an agent wrote without leaving the thread. Agents in the thread can list the columns of the open file and run read-only queries on it, so their answers come from the file. Shows the schema, row groups, codec and per-column statistics from the file's footer, and joins several Parquet files in one query. DuckDB runs as WebAssembly in the panel, and the file is never uploaded. Exporting more than 10,000 rows of a result needs DBConvert PRO ($9 a month).
